title: Bram and the Visitor
author: Sebastian Amberdale
blurb: Theo Iversen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
